title: One-dimensional chess on a Möbius strip, from an idea to a playable preview in 25 hours
summary: On Tue 17 Nov at 19:03Z @mokkenstorm.dev (423 followers) posted "3 player 1d chess on a Möbius strip wormed its way into my brain and now I need to build it". At 22:23Z the same account quote-posted that day's polyhedra video (see made-polyhedra-instruments-sakura) with an image and the words "I hope you don't mind I borrowed your colour scheme for inspiration for 1 dimensional mobius chess"; the alt text is "a circle of chess pieces on a 1 dimensional mobius strip". It has 36 likes. @minormobius.bsky.social replied "That's awesome, I need a website tho" and later "I like! I repost! But I'm not gonna love unless there's a link". On Wed 18 Nov at 15:36Z an account outside the cluster wrote "i can't even imagine how tf this plays"; the maker answered that a playable link was coming and posted a video ("and.. yknow, like this. With ghosts and ninjas"). At 20:29Z the maker posted mobius.mokkenstorm.dev, "sneaky preview on a cloudflare tunnel"; the page title is "ringmate". @minormobius.bsky.social replied "Fuuuuuck that's so goooood"; the maker added "It's multiplayer and agent friendly 👀".

made.what: ringmate: one-dimensional chess on a Möbius strip, playable in a browser preview (the idea post says three players; the maker calls the preview "multiplayer and agent friendly")

couldBeShown: Chess pieces arranged in a circle on a single strip (the image's alt text); a game in play (the video's alt text says only "Video showing Möbius strip 1d chess"). The rules, how pieces move on a one-dimensional strip, and what the twist in the strip does are not described in the data. The colour scheme is borrowed from the polyhedra video, whose colours the data does not describe either.
numbers: 25 h 26 min from the first post about the idea (Tue 19:03Z) to the playable preview (Wed 20:29Z).
3 h 20 min from the idea to the first picture of a board (22:23Z).
